shared_preload_libraries.description: Comma-separated list of shared libraries to preload (must include 'pglogical'). PostgreSQL requires restart to change this.

max_workers.description: Maximum number of pglogical worker processes (publisher/subscriber workers). Increase for higher replication throughput.

max_slots.description: Maximum number of replication slots pglogical may create (per node). Must be ≥ number of active subscriptions.

sync_structure_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for schema synchronization during initial subscription setup. Increase for large databases.

synchronous.description: Whether to use synchronous replication for subscriber commit acknowledgment. Reduces latency but may increase failure risk.

log_level.description: Logging level for pglogical operations. Use 'DEBUG' only for troubleshooting.

verbose.description: Enable verbose per-operation logging (e.g., row-level replication events). Increases log volume significantly.

apply_interval.description: Minimum time (in milliseconds) between apply cycles. Lower values reduce replication lag but increase CPU usage.

conflict_resolution.description: Conflict resolution strategy for updatable subscriptions. Options: 'none', 'apply_first', 'remote_first', 'log'.

conflict_resolver.description: Name of a custom conflict resolver function (e.g., 'pglogical.conflict_log_and_exit'). Leave blank unless using custom logic.

replicated_tables.description: List of tables to replicate (for subscriber configuration). Each entry must specify schema and table name.

replication_sets.description: Publisher-side list of replication sets. Each set groups tables for selective replication.

tables.description: List of tables in this replication set

log_remote_commands.description: Log remote SQL commands executed by pglogical. Useful for auditing but increases log volume.

log_apply_stats.description: Log periodic apply statistics (e.g., latency, rows applied). Helps monitor replication health.

debug_logging.description: Enable pglogical-specific debug logging (same as log_level_debug in newer versions).

extra_params.description: Map of extra PostgreSQL config parameters to include verbatim (e.g., {wal_level: 'logical'}).
